# About Me

Hi, I'm Naqiao Gu. I'm a graduate student in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University, and I expect to finish my degree in January 2027.

My background is in business. I've worked with inventory, orders, and reporting, so I like projects that connect data to everyday operations. I enjoy understanding what's going on and finding a practical way to improve it.

## What I'm learning

In AD688, I have been using Python, SQL, PySpark, AWS EC2, and GitHub. Some of these tools were new to me when I started. I learn best by actually using them instead of only reading about them.

## What interests me

I'm interested in business operations, logistics, and business intelligence. I like working with people and using data to support better decisions. Outside class, I enjoy basketball and collecting model toys.
